summary.headline: Arkade Q1 FY27 revenue INR 147 crore, PAT INR 19 crore (13% margin); pre-sales up 9% YoY to INR 155 crore.
summary.overview: Revenue from operations was INR 147 crore with gross margin stable at 29.1%, while EBITDA margin fell to 18.9% (INR 28 crore) and PAT was INR 19 crore. Management attributed the YoY margin decline to lower other income (no repeat of IPO-proceeds treasury gains) and higher employee costs, with headcount rising from 213 to 277. Collections were INR 164 crore and net debt was INR 5 crore (0.01x net debt-to-equity). Management reiterated a FY27 launch plan of about INR 3,000 crore GDV and a 12,800 crore development pipeline.

financial_highlights.change: Below prior-year levels; management cited ~26-27% historically

segments.name: Residential (Mumbai/MMR)
segments.commentary: Pre-sales INR 155 crore (+9% YoY); development pipeline ~INR 12,800 crore GDV across ~4.2 million sq ft saleable carpet area. Redevelopment is a core focus.

segments.name: Finroof (home loans)
segments.commentary: Banking assistance platform that earns commission revenue on loans, including on non-Arkade projects; management described it as profitable.

segments.name: Assist360 (facility management)
segments.commentary: Currently serves only recently completed Arkade projects; no third-party revenue disclosed.

guidance_outlook: FY27 launches of about INR 3,000 crore GDV; Malad redevelopment (~INR 750 crore topline) in Q3 and Thane project (~INR 2,000 crore sale potential) in Q4; Santa Cruz already launched last quarter.
FY27 pre-sales target from new launches about INR 500 crore, plus about INR 500 crore from ongoing inventory (unsold value ~INR 700 crore as of June 30).
EBITDA margin expected at about 25-26% over the year, versus 18.9% in Q1.
Next year (FY28) launch plan of INR 5,000 crore-plus, including Filmistan and two more projects.
Anand Nagar: wireless station shift expected in FY27, approvals in FY28, launch in FY29.
Management expects roughly 18-19% of PAT to convert into cash flow; target IRR on new projects about 20%-plus.

qa_highlights.question: What pre-sales can be expected from the FY27 launches and ongoing inventory, given only about 500 crore of new-launch pre-sales is targeted?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said about INR 500 crore from new launches and about INR 500 crore from ongoing inventory (about INR 700 crore unsold as of June 30). It said FY27 pre-sales of about INR 1,000 crore is expected, and FY28 will be better with Filmistan and two other launches.

qa_highlights.question: What EBITDA margin should be modelled, given the drop from the historical 26-27% to below 20%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said gross margin is stable at about 29% and the drop is due to lower other income and higher employee costs. It expects EBITDA margin of about 25-26% over the year.

qa_highlights.question: What cash flow is expected from the portfolio?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it expects about 18-19% of PAT to convert into cash flow, and EBITDA at about 25-26%.

qa_highlights.question: Why is Anand Nagar, a top-three GDV project, not launching before FY29?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said there is no delay. Approvals are constrained by a wireless station in Dahisar that limits building height; the station is to shift to Madh Marve, expected in FY27, with approvals in FY28 and launch in FY29.

qa_highlights.question: What does accelerated growth mean?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said FY27 launches of INR 3,000 crore would be roughly double the previous highest of about INR 1,500 crore in a financial year, and FY28 is planned at INR 5,000 crore-plus.

qa_highlights.question: What do Finroof and Assist360 contribute?
qa_highlights.answer: Finroof earns commission on home loans, including on non-Arkade projects, and is profitable. Assist360 currently serves only recently completed Arkade projects, and no third-party revenue was disclosed.

qa_highlights.question: Will the company need incremental debt or equity?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said outright projects are already paid for and net debt is almost nil. It may use construction finance at lower interest rates if required.

qa_highlights.question: What is the target IRR on new projects?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the target is about 20% or more, in line with historical growth.

capex_capacity: Development pipeline about INR 12,800 crore GDV across ~4.2 million sq ft saleable carpet area; management said a similar-size pipeline is at nascent stage (LOIs from societies for redevelopment).
FY27 launches of about INR 3,000 crore GDV: Santa Cruz already launched last quarter, Malad redevelopment (~INR 750 crore topline) in Q3, Thane (~INR 2,000 crore sale potential) in Q4.
Anand Nagar: wireless station to shift from Dahisar to Madh Marve, expected in FY27; approvals in FY28; launch in FY29. Management said an MoU is in place with the society.
FY28 launch plan of INR 5,000 crore-plus, including Filmistan and two more projects; management cited prior launches of not more than INR 1,500 crore in a year.
Funding: outright projects already paid for; net debt at almost nil; construction finance may be used if required at lower interest rates.
demand_pricing: Q1 pre-sales INR 155 crore, up 9% YoY; management cited 9-10% growth and said it does not indicate a slowdown.
FY27 pre-sales guidance: about INR 500 crore from new launches (Q3/Q4 timing) plus about INR 500 crore from ongoing inventory with unsold value about INR 700 crore as of June 30.
Management said launch-phase sales are typically about 20% of GDV at launch (about INR 600 crore on INR 3,000 crore), and that the INR 500 crore figure is conservative.
Industry: top-seven city housing sales above 90,000 units in April-June quarter; sales moderated on Middle East tensions; new launches up 7% YoY (per management).
Gross margin stable at 29.1%; EBITDA margin guided at about 25-26% for the year versus 18.9% in Q1.
Construction cost inflation: management said it is normally absorbed by higher realisation on incremental rates.
Land cost: management said land is about 50% of GDV in South Mumbai and about 15-20% in northern suburbs.
risks_watch: Pre-sales execution: FY27 target of about INR 1,000 crore depends on Q3 (Malad) and Q4 (Thane) launches, which fall late in the year.
Margin recovery: Q1 EBITDA margin 18.9% versus guided 25-26% for the full year; this relies on other income and employee cost trends that management did not quantify.
Anand Nagar approvals depend on wireless station relocation from Dahisar to Madh Marve, which is outside company control.
Demand: management acknowledged moderation in sales volumes from geopolitical tensions in the Middle East; pricing and conversion were not quantified.
Monitor Q2 for Malad and Thane launch timing, Filmistan approvals, and whether a construction-finance facility is drawn.
key_quotes: Our pre-sales for the quarter increased by 9% year-on-year to INR 155 crores, reflecting the strength of our project portfolio and continued customer confidence.
But we expect to maintain EBITDA margin of about 25-26% over the year.
So, we are expecting the wireless station to be shifted in FY27.
So, we have a clear visibility of 12,000 worth of projects getting launched in near future plus a separate pipeline of projects which are being acquired.
summary.management_tone: Confident on growth visibility and balance sheet strength, but vague on specifics: it gave no quantified answers on pricing, competition or the timing of the wireless station shift. Management was more direct on pre-sales and margin guidance than on the risks to launch timing.

growth.why: Guides ~INR 3,000 crore GDV of FY27 launches (Santa Cruz done, Malad in Q3, Thane in Q4) and ~INR 500 crore new-launch pre-sales plus ~INR 500 crore from ~INR 700 crore unsold inventory, with EBITDA margin 25-26% for the year vs 18.9% in Q1; launch timing is specific but no revenue growth % is stated and the brief gives no revenue growth figure, so backing is partial.
